sloka: स्वागतम् ते महा बाहो तव इयम् अखिला मही ।वयम् प्रेष्या भवान् भर्ता साधु राज्यम् प्रशाधि नः ॥२-५०-३८॥
transliteration: svāgatam te mahā bāho tava iyam akhilā mahī ।vayam preṣyā bhavān bhartā sādhu rājyam praśādhi naḥ ॥2-50-38॥

translations.english: he swiftly presented the guest-offering and spoke these words: "Welcome to you, mighty-armed one. This whole earth is yours."
